$notYetAppliedOrdinals_note: 0049 (playtime - PlayTime Tracker) was applied to canonical production on 2026-09-17 under CEO approval, recorded at its exact repo version 20260916210000 after the tool-stamped version (20260917004911) was reconciled, per the XI-2L procedure. 0048 (ats) was applied out of band at 20260916190643 and has NOT been reconciled - see knownMigrationDrift. See docs/architecture-audit/playtime-0049-production-deployment/.

knownMigrationDrift.$comment: ACTIVE DRIFT, discovered 2026-09-17 during the 0049 pre-flight read. The repository and canonical production have forked lineages. Recorded rather than quietly tolerated: check-lineage-drift.mjs exists precisely to fail on this and has evidently not been run against the live project. None of it was caused by the 0049 apply, and none of it touches the playtime schema, which is additive. Only drift on an ordinal THIS repo owns can be expressed in `entries` (the checker validates repoVersion against the file); everything else is under $driftBeyondThisRepo.

entries.detail: 0048 (ats) is APPLIED to canonical production at the tool-stamped version 20260916190643, never reconciled to the repo version. Until 2026-09-17 this repository stated in three places that 0048 was UNAPPLIED; the `ats` schema has existed in production since 2026-09-16. The SQL of the two was not compared.
entries.remedy: Reconcile production's ledger row to 20260916120000 (XI-2L procedure) or rename the repo file to production's version (XI-2I Option D), after diffing the SQL. A decision, not a guess.

$driftBeyondThisRepo.$comment: Drift that cannot be an `entries` row because it concerns migrations this repository does not contain. Counts read from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations 2026-09-17.

duplicateOrdinals.detail: Production holds TWO hlbos_0048_* migrations (barberos_capability_catalog at 20260909203027, ats_resume_optimizer at 20260916190643) and, since 2026-09-17, TWO hlbos_0049_* (transform_audit at 20260909203607, playtime_tracker at 20260916210000). Ordinals 0048-0058 in production belong to a lineage this repository has never seen. The hlbos_ prefix scheme exists specifically to stop two counters sharing one range (see the header of scripts/check-migrations.sh), and that is now exactly what has happened.
duplicateOrdinals.note: 0049 was applied under explicit CEO approval with this collision already present. Its version is unique and monotonic, so the ledger is internally consistent; the ambiguity is in the ordinal label, and it is reported, not hidden.

foreignLineages.detail: 38 migrations from six foreign lineages, plus 12 hlbos_*-named migrations (barberos, transform audit, proposal, discovery call, shop API, product map, client CRM), are applied to canonical production and exist nowhere in this repository. One is named temp_perftest_page_twin.

$driftBeyondThisRepo.remedy: DECIDED 2026-09-17 by the CEO: separate the product lineage into its own Supabase project. Measurement then showed the out-of-band work is TWO things, not one, and they need opposite treatment -- see docs/architecture-audit/lineage-split/. Group A (jobscout, dma, barberos, transform_audit: 60 tables, 959 rows) is genuinely separate product work and moves. Group B (disco, plus the hlvs_board_*, ingest_* and temp_perftest_* migrations: 5 tables, 136 rows) is HL-BOS's own Venture Studio work applied off-book -- every one of those migrations touches vstudio, which is this repository's own 342 MB schema, so moving it would tear Venture Studio in half. Group B gets ADOPTED into supabase/migrations instead. Execution is blocked on two things, neither of them a decision: create_project timed out three times on 2026-09-17 with nothing created, and the consuming applications (hl-jobscout, homehuddle, and a BarberOS repo not yet located) are outside this session's scope. Nothing has been moved and nothing has been dropped; HL-BOS Core is untouched.

resolvedMigrationDrift.$comment: HISTORICAL record of the reconciled drift (Phase XI-2I, 2026-07-31, Option D). Repo migration files 0023–0027 were renamed from their old version identifiers to production's applied versions; content byte-identical (sha256 before==after) and normalized SQL matched production. See docs/architecture-audit/hlvs-phase-11-2i-reconciliation-execution/01-reconciliation-audit.md and ADR-0002 addendum.
resolvedMigrationDrift.mechanism: Option D — repository filename reconciliation (git mv, content preserved)
